about.title: About the Chilling Reign set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Chilling Reign is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 18 June 2021. It has 233 cards: 198 in the main set and 35 secret rares. There are also 136 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 198 main set cards), the Master set (334 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 369 cards, adding the 35 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
